item.title: Question
item.content:encoded: I mostly love this one for the questions it brings up to me: How accurate is the Postman? If the letter is posted to someone already deceased, will anything happen? If the targeted recipient dies before the delivery interval / before the suicide, does he deliver to the morgue / grave? What if an unrelated intermediary inserts the letter, or if the recipient puts it in? Self-addressed mail?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Overall, I like it. But I think you've over-redacted in a couple spots. I don't think that this sentence: "The address on the letter will be altered to reflect the change in location, however no evidence of alteration is present, suggesting the use of [REDACTED]." needs anything after the last comma, for one. And I'm assuming that "Possible links to SCP-███ are currently being investigated." refers to SCP-662, and don't think it needs to be blacked out if that's the case. Also, I like the interview, but cringed at the "But had it always been there last week?" question. I can't stand behind a direct Discworld quote in a serious article.
